reason: Canonical turn-flow owner for tool evidence, stage reconciliation, and lifecycle finalize should replace live legacy field back-projection.
Stream SSE handlers must project live tool/native-search events only into canonical turnFlow instead of mutating msg.toolCalls.
Stream terminalization should detect orphaned running tools from canonical turn-flow evidence rather than legacy toolCalls.
Display selectors must prefer canonical turnFlow and keep legacy fields bounded to persisted-history fallback.
Regression coverage must assert live stream tool-card rendering reads canonical selectors and no longer depends on msg.toolCalls back-projection.
